soldier_resources.title: Army Garrison & Soldier Support Resources Directory
soldier_resources.description: Essential military support programs, garrison services, and command resources for Soldiers and families.

resources.name: Better Opportunities for Single Soldiers
resources.description: Enhances the quality of life and morale of single Soldiers, increases Soldier involvement in communities, and assists in identifying issues.
resources.eligibility: Single Soldiers, Single Parents, and Geographical Single Soldiers.

resources.name: Military and Family Life Counseling
resources.description: Provides non-medical, short-term, confidential counseling to Soldiers and family members to cope with deployment, stress, and lifestyle changes.
resources.eligibility: Active Duty Soldiers, Guard/Reserve, and immediate Family Members.

resources.name: Unit Ministry Team / Chaplain
resources.description: Offers confidential religious support, pastoral care, moral advice, and marital/personal counseling.
resources.eligibility: 100% Confidential for all Soldiers and Family Members.

resources.name: Army Emergency Relief
resources.description: Provides interest-free loans, grants, and educational scholarships to relieve financial distress.
resources.eligibility: Active Duty, Retirees, and eligible Dependents.

resources.name: American Red Cross Service to the Armed Forces
resources.description: Delivers emergency message communications (births, deaths, illness) between service members and their families worldwide 24/7.
resources.eligibility: All active duty military members and their immediate families.

resources.name: Army Community Service
resources.description: Offers comprehensive social, financial, deployment, relocation, and family readiness programs.
resources.eligibility: Active Duty, Reserve, National Guard, Retirees, and Family Members.

resources.name: Military Family Readiness
resources.description: Connects commanders, Soldiers, and family members with information, support, and garrison assistance programs.
resources.eligibility: Soldiers and Family Members assigned to the unit.

resources.name: Behavioral Health Readiness / Clinic
resources.description: Provides specialized clinical mental health treatment, assessment, and resilience services for operational readiness.

resources.name: Staff Judge Advocate (SJA) Legal Assistance
resources.description: Assists with personal legal matters, including wills, powers of attorney, leases, family law, and consumer protection.
resources.eligibility: Active Duty, Retirees, and eligible Dependents.

resources.name: Army Education Center
resources.description: Provides Tuition Assistance (TA), testing center access, degree plan counseling, and ArmyIgnitED support.
resources.eligibility: Active Duty, Guard, and Reserve Soldiers.

resources.name: Sexual Harassment/Assault Response and Prevention
resources.description: Provides 24/7 advocacy, reporting options (Restricted/Unrestricted), medical accompaniment, and support services.

resources.name: Equal Opportunity Program
resources.description: Formulates, directs, and sustains a comprehensive effort to maximize human potential and ensure fair treatment based solely on merit, fitness, and capability.
